status: exploratory descriptive audit; formal acceptance belongs to summarize_k15.py

definitions.none: No 5-consecutive-step goal XY entry while book is >3cm above step-1 height, by absolute step400; does not mean no movement.
definitions.window_end: At boundary+60 after the patch window; displacement relative to common boundary, lift relative to step1.
definitions.contacts: Simultaneous geometric contacts with the two fingers; not a force/secure-grasp measurement.
definitions.requested_box_xy_gap_m: Euclidean XY distance to the requested compartment rectangle; zero is inside its horizontal projection.
definitions.orientation: Book orientation relative to gripper compared with boundary, not world orientation.
definitions.clip: First6 arm versus seventh gripper pre-clamp components outside [-1,1]. Executed values inferred from archived source's exact clamp, not a separate recorded executed vector.
definitions.inference_limit: These trajectory associations describe failure forms; they do not locate training-update causes or establish mediators as causal.
